name: Raymarching with 3D Volume Texture
definition: A volume rendering technique that replaces 2D texture atlases with a single 3D volume texture (sampler3D) for raymarching, allowing larger XYZ volumes and sharing memory representation with pathtrace/isosurface modes.
summary: Raymarching with 3D Volume Texture renders voxel data as a sampler3D texture in the fragment shader, avoiding meshing overhead and enabling larger volumes via a unified in-memory representation.
